name: mypka-cockpit
description: myPKA Cockpit — a navigable, wikilink-aware viewer over your myPKA. Reads mypka.db read-only, with one documented carve-out: the three podcast_episodes.manual_watched* columns (DATA-CONTRACT §18.9, server/podcastsDb.js). Markdown write surface is Fleeting Notes only (PKM/Fleeting Notes/).

scripts.serve:lan: npm run build && COCKPIT_BIND_LAN=1 node server/server.js
scripts.food:test: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_food_*.py' && node --test server/tracking.food.test.mjs
scripts.habit:test: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_habit_*.py' && node --test server/tracking.habits.test.mjs
scripts.food:capture-status: bash -lc 'launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep nl.gewoonsander.food-capture || echo food-capture-not-loaded'
